key_findings: Default development phases are capped at 100 nodes and P14/1000 is not automatic.
Real Valkey evidence must come from wrapper scripts, not project tests alone.
Missing metrics must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
L09 must extend stability and soak from short smoke into baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post-recovery metric stages.
Harness must cover fake timeline tests, small real soak gate, and 30/50/100 bounded or resource-aware profiles.
Each soak profile must output JSONL time series and short windows must be marked bounded.
Current P11 stability logic lives in write_stability_artifacts.
Current smoke uses interval_count 3 and ops_per_interval 12.
Current artifacts do not encode named baseline, steady, fault, recovery, or post-recovery windows.
Existing evidence has real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.0, nodes_observed 6, cluster_state_observed ok, and data_path_result PASS.
It does not prove 30/50/100 stability soak behavior.

findings.description: Current stability capability is a short bounded P11 smoke, not the required multi-stage soak model.
evidence: write_stability_artifacts uses interval_count=3 and no named stage/window field.
stability_report.json has no baseline, steady, fault, recovery, or post-recovery windows.

findings.description: There is no 30/50/100 stability soak evidence or resource-aware stability profile artifact set.
evidence: P12/P13 artifacts contain scale and fault/failover reports, but no stability_soak_30/50/100 JSONL or stability report.
build_metric_coverage_matrix.py only extracts stability metrics from P11 small-real artifacts.

findings.description: The stability schema is too permissive to enforce L09 required metrics and missing semantics.
evidence: schemas/artifact/stability_report.schema.json does not require window summaries, JSONL paths, missing metric reasons, or bounded profile metadata.

proposed_harness.name: stability_multistage_fake_timeline_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Deterministic fake samples produce baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post-recovery windows with ordered timestamps, JSONL rows, per-window latency percentiles, memory growth, restart deltas, error taxonomy, and explicit missing reasons.

proposed_harness.name: strict_stability_multistage_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Schemas require stability report and JSONL rows to include stage/window identity, bounded profile metadata, source paths, latency p50/p95/p99 or explicit missing objects, memory/leak summaries, restart deltas, error taxonomy, baseline comparison, and missing metric reasons.

proposed_harness.name: bounded_30_50_100_soak_profiles
proposed_harness.acceptance: 30, 50, and 100 profiles run only after resource preflight; successful runs emit bounded multi-stage stability artifacts, while resource insufficiency records a genuine blocker and cannot be marked PASS.

implementation_plan.step: Define L09 artifact contracts before feature implementation.
implementation_plan.rationale: L09 needs schema-first enforcement for windows, trend metrics, missing semantics, and bounded profile metadata.

implementation_plan.step: Implement multi-stage soak model and JSONL writer.
implementation_plan.rationale: The existing CLI contract should produce baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post-recovery windows while preserving P11 behavior.

implementation_plan.step: Implement L09 artifact audit and coverage extraction.
implementation_plan.rationale: Machine-readable artifacts must drive metric coverage and reject fabricated, missing, or report-derived values.

acceptance_criteria: Previous harness baseline remains PASS before and after L09 changes.
Each L09 soak profile emits a JSONL time series with schema_version, artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, timestamp, source, stage/window name, and metrics or explicit missing objects.
Small real stability soak evidence is wrapper-produced with real_valkey true, Valkey version prefix 9.1., live node probes, data-path proof, schema validation PASS, and cleanup PASS.
30, 50, and 100 stability soak profiles either run bounded real gates after passing resource preflight or record a genuine BLOCKED resource result.
All short automatic soak windows are marked bounded and cannot claim long-run stability.
risks: 30/50/100 real soak gates may exceed local Docker CPU, memory, port, or timeout budgets.
Short bounded runs can be misread as long-run stability.
Missing restart counts, memory values, or latency samples may be accidentally converted to zero.
Report integration can accidentally source metrics from rendered views instead of JSON/JSONL artifacts.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run or count P14/1000 real stability, fault, failover, or soak gates without explicit user opt-in and the required environment variable.
Do not claim long-run stability from short bounded soak windows.
Do not mark 30/50/100 resource-preflight failure as PASS.
Do not use fake tests, generated logs, static files, or project tests alone as real Valkey evidence.
Do not fabricate memory, latency, restart, baseline, fault, recovery, or error metrics.
commands_to_run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp/valkey-scale-lab-pycache python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/stability tests/coverage tests/report tests/ci/test_stability_soak_metrics_gate.py
notes: Requirements are clear enough for harness design. L09 must preserve P11 behavior while adding multi-stage, bounded, artifact-first stability evidence.
